assessment.overall: Russian is generally comprehensible and preserves most plots, morals, emotions and dialogue. Confirmed problems are localized semantic omissions, dialogue shifts, opaque cultural idioms and grammar. Optional literal wording should receive targeted polish. Five source poems have no Russian translation in either supplied version. This is model-assisted assessment, not native validation.
source_ambiguities: AZ frequently does not specify narrator gender; Russian gender selection is not automatically a semantic error.
garden-and-the-gardener denies a simple gardener-only explanation while its moral balances help and personal effort; the conceptual tension is inherited from AZ.
Historical claims embedded in the source, including Durer, Diderot, Ottoman customs and the 1919 memoir, were not fact-checked and must not be attributed to translation error.
no-need-to-be-sane-when-everyone-is-mad: title/action and moral pull in different directions in AZ as well as RU.
pawn-and-the-king: the pawn becoming a king is a chess-inaccurate source image, not a Russian-added mistake.
shepherd-must-be-called: rabid dogs becoming obedient is an inherited source inconsistency.
three-best-things: giving others a place in your heart versus taking a place in others’ hearts differs between source dialogue and source moral; RU retains both.
to-give-up: family-love/reverence wording permits receiving-versus-showing interpretations; a bilingual reviewer should clarify intent before changing the Russian.
weight-of-the-oil: the informal hand-balance measurement is inherited from AZ.

assessment.conclusion: All 256 available Kyrgyz translations were read in full against Azerbaijani. Most are comprehensible and preserve plot, dialogue, emotion, moral and cultural setting. Thirteen stories have essential localized findings (three P1 semantic/moral changes and ten P2 clarity issues); six have optional P3 refinements; 237 have no material issue identified. Five poems have neither Kyrgyz DOCX nor published target. High-confidence reversals deserve priority; medium-confidence usage judgments require native bilingual confirmation. No native validation or external historical/medical verification was performed.

assessment.orthography_policy: Prior requested ə→a is authoritative. ciyar in liver needs an explicit linguistic-term orthography decision, not automatic reversal.

source_questions.question: Confirm the intended pejorative force of the nickname: a slowpoke/trödlerin, a command to come here, or a deliberately adapted name. EN and RU currently use a summoning command; DE retains the name and explains it as Trödlerin.
source_questions.priority: Author clarification before changing the nickname in any language

source_questions.question: Preserve the narrator's complex retrospective judgment alongside the explicitly described violence. This sentence must not be strengthened into a claim that he treated her well, nor silently removed because it is uncomfortable.

source_questions.az_quote: Kasıbı soymaqdansa, imkanlının haqsız qazancını almaq daha ədalətlidir.
source_questions.question: The narrative describes threats and bargaining; it does not explicitly establish all the wealth as unlawful. Confirm whether the intended reading is social justice, ironic criticism, or a knowingly morally complex anecdote. Do not resolve the tension independently in translation.

source_questions.az_quote: İnsan ucundan bucağından qarışsa da qarışdığı işdən az-çox yararlanar.
source_questions.question: The beekeeper protests while the grocer invokes the proverb. Confirm whether the final lesson is a neutral observation about incidental benefit or an ironic exposure of self-serving excuses. Preserve the ambiguity pending a decision.

source_questions.az_quote: Başımıza gələnin kökünü çox vaxt öz əməllərimizdə tapmaq olar.
source_questions.question: Keep the qualifying phrase çox vaxt (often) and the dervish's religious setting. Do not make the translation assert that all suffering is deserved. Any additional reader framing should be separate and author-approved.

Optional first-use 'historische Gewichtseinheit' gloss would make the setting easier to read; do not invent a fixed kilogram conversion.
findings.source_ambiguity: The source supplies neither region-specific value nor a conversion for batman.
